verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is an iOS terminal and SSH/Mosh client, and a terminal app could plausibly ship local Git tooling, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never mentions Git or submodules. The documented local commands (cat, grep, ls, cp and similar) and file-transfer tools (scp, sftp, curl) include no git, and the only Git-adjacent mention is connecting to remote VS Code or Codespaces environments, which is not Blink's own capability.
